new_need.sentence: How many people actually read LindyBooks these days?

questions.question: How many distinct people actually read LindyBooks in the recent period?
questions.quantity: Distinct human readers who genuinely engaged with LindyBooks content (e.g. opened and read an article/book/issue beyond a minimal engagement threshold, not merely loaded a page or received an email) during the window
questions.population: Real human readers of LindyBooks (website/publication/product), counted once per person across devices where identifiable
exclude: subscribers or list members who did not read
bounces and accidental opens (e.g. email auto-opens, prefetch)
duplicate counts of the same person across devices/sessions

questions.question: Is the number of actual readers rising or falling versus earlier periods?
questions.quantity: Change in distinct engaged readers for the latest 30d versus the prior 30d and 90d

relation.description: same_need: built to answer what the new need asks (however well it answers today); can_do: the new request is something it can already do through its interface, as it is; extend: it holds the data or is the place the principal uses for this, but lacks something the request needs; unrelated

covered.description: ids of the new questions or requirements it covers

gaps.description: what the new need asks that it cannot do today

gaps: Measures 'active users' (with payment-count proxy), not necessarily readers engaged beyond a reading threshold
Unknown whether it supports 7d/30d/90d windows explicitly
